test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Teena said that the servant might come the next day.

options.text: Teena said, "The servant will come tomorrow."
Teena said, "The servant may come today."
Teena said, "The servant will be coming tomorrow."
Teena said, "The servant may come tomorrow."

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Direct speech involves conveying someone's words verbatim.
 
• To convert the reported speech into direct speech, we need to directly quote what Teena said.
 
• The modal verb **"might"** in reported speech can be transformed into **"may"** in direct speech to maintain the meaning.
 
• Hence, The correct direct speech form is **"Teena said, 'The servant may come tomorrow.'"**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is -** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** This option changes the modal verb "might" to "will," altering the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** This option changes the modal verb "might" to "may," but it alters the timeframe from "the next day" to "today," which is not consistent with the original statement.
 
• **Option 3:** This option changes the modal verb "might" to "will be," altering the meaning of the original sentence.
